hooks.name: Automated Code Review
hooks.description: Automatically runs code review when TypeScript files are saved

action.command: node .kiro/agents/review-script.js "${KIRO_FILE_PATH}" > /tmp/kiro-review.log 2>&1 && echo "✅ Code review completed for ${KIRO_FILE_PATH}" || echo "⚠️ Code review failed for ${KIRO_FILE_PATH}"
